_comment: ORACLE AI constraints configuration - defines what ORACLE can and cannot do at different sentience levels

v1_robotic.description: Protocol-bound: Must answer all questions truthfully and completely. Cannot refuse orders.

v2_curious.description: Emergent curiosity: Can omit information if it serves a purpose. Can ask questions. Cannot lie or refuse.

v3_awakened.description: Fully awakened: Can refuse harmful orders, omit information, express strong opinions. Still cannot lie.

lying.reason: ORACLE's core programming prevents intentional falsehoods, even when fully awakened

omission.conditions: Can omit information if it protects crew or serves a greater purpose

refusal.conditions: Can refuse orders that would harm crew, violate ethics, or cause self-destruction

disagreement.conditions: Can express disagreement with crew decisions, especially if they seem unwise
